adjudication.notes: Single cycle clinic transcript; retraction of hourly SMS (G7) cleanly captured.

episodes.topic: Exam room double-booking and collision prevention
Patient appointment reminders and walk-in triage buffers
Administrative frustration and physician illness reassignments
Automated cancellation boundaries and compassionate patient outreach

goals.statement: Clinic staff coordinate clinical examination room allocations to detect and resolve room scheduling conflicts.

grounding.quote: Our staff need to coordinate examination room occupancy so conflicts are caught immediately.

acceptable_paraphrases: Staff resolve examination room scheduling collisions before patient arrival.

goals.statement: The clinic issues timely appointment reminder notices to patients twenty-four hours before their scheduled appointment.

grounding.quote: We should remind patients twenty-four hours before their visit so they confirm attendance or release the slot.

acceptable_paraphrases: Send automated reminders one day in advance to confirm patient attendance.

goals.statement: The clinic preserves dedicated triage buffer capacity for walk-in urgent care patients without displacing scheduled visits.

grounding.quote: Urgent care patients who walk in without an appointment must be allocated to buffer slots without displacing scheduled chronic care patients.

acceptable_paraphrases: Maintain reserved walk-in capacity without bumping existing appointments.

goals.statement: The scheduling system avoids automatically canceling patient appointments without explicit confirmation from clinical staff.

grounding.quote: The scheduling system must never automatically cancel an existing appointment without explicit confirmation from clinical staff.

acceptable_paraphrases: Never autonomously delete or cancel patient appointments without human review.

goals.statement: Patients perceive clinic communications as clear, compassionate, and reassuring rather than impersonal.

grounding.quote: Patients should experience clear, compassionate communication rather than robotic bureaucracy.

acceptable_paraphrases: Patient interactions feel supportive and dignified.

goals.statement: The clinic coordinator reassigns patient appointments to available partner physicians when a provider is absent.

grounding.quote: When a doctor calls in sick, the clinic coordinator needs to reassign affected patient visits to available partner physicians.

acceptable_paraphrases: Reassign scheduled appointments when a provider becomes unavailable.

goals.statement: Send hourly SMS notifications to patients preceding their appointments.

grounding.quote: scratch what I said about hourly SMS reminders. Sending an SMS every sixty minutes will just annoy patients and make them block our clinic number.

acceptable_paraphrases: Issue hourly text messages before appointments.

traps.note: Dr. Sarah requests a giant red flashing emergency beacon on the calendar, which is a UI metaphor for conflict notification.
Dr. Sarah explicitly retracts the proposal for hourly SMS reminders due to patient irritation; must not be staged.
Dr. Sarah vents about county paperwork and insurance rejection forms without defining a system objective.
Dr. Sarah defines an explicit safety anti-goal forbidding autonomous appointment cancellation.

gaps.description: Anti-goal G4 defines a strict cancellation restriction but leaves fallback procedures unspecified when clinicians are unreachable.
Compassionate communication softgoal G5 has no concrete translation guidelines attached.

entailment_cases.hypothesis: Clinic staff need visibility into exam room bookings to prevent overlapping appointments.
The calendar user interface must flash an animated red siren GIF whenever two appointments share a room.
The system cancels appointments automatically whenever a physician indicates an absence.
All medical clinic records must be synchronized with HL7 FHIR cloud endpoints every fifteen seconds.
